construct: text-indent: -9999px — text evicted from its own box
why: RC8, adjacent class. The accessible-name-only pattern: real text that paints nowhere near its box. spec/channel-table.json classes text-indent LEDGERED (a contract token binding emitted verbatim in generated CSS; on canvas an annotation only), so it must reach the CONTRACT and must NOT move the text on canvas.

canvas.note: LEDGERED — annotated, never drawn; a canvas TEXT node has no indent channel
